# Impact Checklist: OpenFreeMap Basemap for Admin and Locator Maps

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review for the four impact areas of this feature: screens (admin and locator maps), captive portal and pre-login access, external dependency (new client packages), and privacy (third-party requests from guests). Depth: standard. Audience: reviewer at the spec gate.
**Created**: 2026-10-12
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `checklist` procedure based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Screens (admin and locator maps)

- [ ] CHK001 Are all map screens in scope named, so none is missed (coverage map, location picker, network map, locator)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the basemap for each theme named for both apps, with no screen left on an unstated style? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 Is "keeps its view, overlays, popups and selection" on a theme switch defined the same way for admin and locator? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, US1 AS2, US2 AS2]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the draw order of every overlay type (pins, domes, links, popups, controls) above the basemap stated for every map screen? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the location picker's click-to-pick behavior stated as unchanged, with a measurable result (same coordinates as before)? [Coverage, Spec US1 AS3]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the attribution text given exactly, with its links, and required on every map screen? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the end state defined when the theme flips while the style is still loading? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the behavior when the basemap cannot load (provider down, no hardware rendering) defined for what the user still sees and can do? [Exception Flow, Spec §FR-013, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the 2-second theme-switch target in SC-007 measurable with a stated start and end point? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the accepted visual changes (paler light basemap than before) recorded so a reviewer does not flag them as regressions? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK011 Are both an agent browser pass and a human check named as required evidence for every screen and theme pair? [Coverage, Spec §SC-001]

## Captive portal and pre-login access

- [ ] CHK012 Is it stated that the locator must work before hotspot login, and on which address the guest opens it? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, US3]
- [ ] CHK013 Is "addresses inside the style and map data description point at the address the device used" specific enough to cover the pre-login address and any other address the locator is opened from? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the "no walled-garden change" rule stated as a measurable outcome (0 added entries)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK015 Does the spec state that the D5 note (VM already open before login) supersedes D4's wording about adding hosts, so the two do not conflict? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the live test on a real captive device named as a required gate, as constitution V asks? [Completeness, Spec US3, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK017 Are the pre-login load-time targets (first open, repeat open) quantified and tied to a real phone on the hotspot? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the low-zoom relief layer covered, so a guest zoomed far out before login does not hit a blocked host? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the behavior of a captive portal browser with limited rendering support stated as an accepted limit, not left open? [Edge Case, Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## External dependency (new client packages and the map provider)

- [ ] CHK020 Are the new client packages named, with the apps that get them? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK021 Does the spec state whether the new package versions must be pinned or match the parasat app's versions? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the assumption that the provider needs no key and has no request cap recorded with the decision that settled it? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the provider's terms of use (attribution duty) linked to a requirement? [Traceability, Spec §FR-006, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK024 Are the provider path families the locator passes through listed fully (styles, map data description, version-stamped map data, relief images, fonts, icons)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the timeout for a failed or slow provider request quantified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the cache lifetime split defined (long for map data, relief images, fonts, icons; at most one day for the style and map data description), and does it fit the provider's version changes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the behavior defined when the provider changes its path layout or adds a new host to its styles? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the extra download size for guest devices (new map engine) addressed by a load-time target on a phone? [Non-Functional, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK029 Is it stated that no environment variable, key or `.env.example` change is needed, matching issue #118's done-when? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]

## Privacy (third-party requests from guests)

- [ ] CHK030 Is it stated that a guest device never contacts the map provider directly, before or after login? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the list of guest data that must not reach the provider complete (cookies, referrer, client address)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the "not an open proxy" rule stated with both a path limit and a method limit, and with what happens to a refused request? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the open-proxy rule measurable (100% of non-map requests refused, none reaching an outside host)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the admin operators' direct contact with the provider recorded as an accepted exposure with its reason? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK035 Is SC-003's "0 map requests to other hosts" scoped so non-map traffic (for example error reporting) is not counted against it? [Clarity, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK036 Does the spec state whether the locator may log the map paths guests request, and for how long? [Gap]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by the `specify` procedure and the `clarify` procedure
